verdict.rationale: Luma's homepage says its Agents generate and refine across video, image, and audio. That is a first-party claim of audio generation in the same workspace, but nothing describes sound effects, ambient audio, or music being matched to a generated scene. Missing for 10: documented sound-effect, ambient, or music generation; scene-matched or synchronized audio for video clips; audio controls in the video workflow or API; and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text
